name: Dan's Drive-In (Montpelier, ID) Hand-Pressed Cheeseburger & Fresh Home-Cut Fries
whyItWorks: Fresh-never-frozen hand-pressed Idaho beef patty on a soft bun; ordering it plain with American/Cheddar cheese makes a reliable stop on the north end of Bear Lake.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a single Cheeseburger plain (meat, cheese, bun, light ketchup) and eat only the soft centers of the fresh home-cut Idaho fries (leaving dark potato skins behind).
watchOuts: Home-cut fries retain potato skins—eat lightly or stick to the burger
Skip fried onion rings on the Rodeo Burger
